_meta.notes: 2024 form 'For a Candidate'; 'Seven days before a general election' checked; neither amendment box marked; date 10/29/2024 typed. No county grid pages: cover, Summary, then filer's own 'Schedule A_Itemized Contribution Report' (p3-p7, attachment pp.1-5; adds a Note column and Last Name/Organization Name header) and 'Schedule B_Itemized Expenditures Made' (p8-p10, attachment pp.1-3; In_Kind column with 'x' marks on 14 hybrid-advertising rows). Schedule A amounts print as bare numbers ('100', '15.75') except the four in-kind rows which print '$1,500.00'. One ActBlue row (line 10) is a 15.75 'Refunded Processing Fees' entry. Org donors carry blank First Name. Address+City+State+Zip under one bar on every A row. Schedule B not redacted. Document contradicts the chunk file only in c_rows basis wording (audit 'counted' 226 confirmed exactly).

contributions.detail: printed Summary line 1 Col A = attachment TOTAL on p7 = 92,113.75; the 226 itemized rows sum to 85,113.75 -- stated exceeds the printed rows by exactly 7,000.00. Four rows are form-marked in-kind ('In-Kind Hybrid Advertising', Committee To Elect Natalie Pinkney, $1,500.00 each = 6,000.00); the delta does NOT equal the in-kind sum, so this is not the in-kind-exclusion pattern. Every amount on p3-p6 was re-read in 600dpi strips and matched; row count 226 = the audit's counted figure. Stated total is not itemization-backed; itemized is a floor.

expenditures.detail: 131 rows sum to 271,129.76 = Summary line 2 Col A = attachment Total on p10, to the cent. 14 rows carry an 'x' in the form's In_Kind column (18,000.00) and ARE included in the printed Total.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: no per-page subtotals on either attachment; grand-total gates: Schedule A TOTAL 92,113.75 (p7) vs itemized 85,113.75 (does NOT close, delta -7,000.00, see recon); Schedule B Total 271,129.76 (p10) = itemized exactly
